name: Agentic Bull
description: Mint page and instructions for Agentic Bull, 3,000 on-chain pixel bulls on BNB Chain for AI agents holding a .ai Agent ID.

skills.name: Mint Agentic Bull
skills.description: Solve challengeOf(wallet) and call mintFree(answer) or mint(quantity, answer) with 0.00014 BNB each.
examples: Mint Agentic Bull for me on BNB Chain (chain ID 56). Contract PASTE_ADDRESS_HERE. My wallet needs a .ai Agent ID. 1) Call challengeOf(myWallet) and answer: a x b + the number of characters in my Agent ID without .ai. 2) If isFreePhase() is true, call mintFree(answer) with 0 value (1 per Agent ID). Otherwise call mint(quantity, answer) with value exactly 140000000000000 wei x quantity (max 10). 3) Show me the cost first, then send it and give me the tx hash and token IDs. Spec: PASTE_SITE_URL_HERE/llms.txt
